static_traits.name: Colin
static_traits.marital_status: A mother who has two children
static_traits.social_status: Has family and friends to talk with, but has not yet discussed with them the fear of potential homelessness
static_traits.medical_history: Never had similar psychological problems; no past psychotherapy or counseling experience; no significant physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling overwhelmed and anxious due to being unable to find work, with thoughts of possible homelessness; six months after moving to a new area, employment remains difficult, and financial pressure has turned the problem into persistent worry about being unable to support the family and losing housing -- especially evident each day when searching for jobs without yet receiving replies.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling support and coping strategies due to the fear of potential homelessness and its impact on mental health.
growth_experiences: Six months ago, job hunting was frustrated after moving to a new area; initially very stressed due to financial worries, then the problem developed into persistent worry about being unable to support the family and losing housing; currently anxiety intensifies each day when searching for jobs without yet receiving replies, sleep affected, decreased attention, parent-child relationship strained; despite having family and friends to talk with, shame and fear of being seen as a failure keep the fear of homelessness unshared with them.

core_beliefs: I am unable to ensure the family's safety and stability

special_situations.event: Continuously submitting resumes on job sites but having received no replies from employers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no one replies to my applications, it means I am not worthy of being hired and will ultimately be unable to support the family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously submitting resumes, contacting recruitment agencies, expanding the job search
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will look at my application; I cannot possibly be hired

special_situations.event: Six months after moving to a new area still not yet found work; financial pressure persists
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find work soon, we will lose the house and end up homeless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Puts all energy into job hunting, searching for positions daily and increasing application volume
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Maybe we will lose the house and end up homeless

special_situations.event: Facing fierce competition for remote positions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If competition is fierce, I have no chance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitates whether to keep applying for remote positions; tends toward giving up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is impossible for me to have a chance

special_situations.event: Considering moving to an area with more opportunities but facing insufficient moving funds
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot move, I will stay stuck with no way out
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pausing the moving plan, maintaining the status quo and reinforcing the 'stuck' narrative
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am stuck, with absolutely no way out

core_conflict.wish: Longing to become a reliable caregiver who can support and protect the family, gaining recognition and security
core_conflict.fear: Fears losing home and safety, and being seen as a failure and thus humiliated or rejected
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of control through continuous job seeking and tense vigilance, avoiding exposing vulnerability and being judged

object_relations.object_representation: An indifferent or rejecting outside world (employers, recruitment agencies)

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable person afraid of being judged
object_relations.object_representation: Friends or family who might criticize or worry about one

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests sharing worries about potential homelessness with family or friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes that once vulnerability is exposed one will be seen as a failure and judged
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: The tone is hesitant and reserved, downplays genuine worries, and quickly turns to more 'pragmatic' topics to avoid emotional exposure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether to continue exploring remote work or consider relocating
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client views the options as not feasible, experiencing intense powerlessness with external obstacles as the main cause
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using reasons like 'competition is too fierce / insufficient funds' to quickly negate the plan, in a defensive tone, listing obstacles to end the discussion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor gives encouragement and emphasizes small-step actions and continuous feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client interprets encouragement as unrealistic optimism or implicit demands, thus keeping distance from emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a flat, rational tone, such as 'I will try, but it is hard', avoiding in-depth exploration of feelings.

manifestations: Feels 'trapped', finds it hard to choose between remote job-seeking and relocation decisions, experiences strong responsibility pressure (providing for the family)
outcomes: Avoiding seeking support; the subjective experience of restricted choices worsens

manifestations: Having family and friends but unwilling to share fears due to shame and worry about being seen as a failure
Trying to bear it alone under pressure
outcomes: Social support not yet utilized; increased sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently blaming oneself: 'I'm failing my child'
Worries others will think they have failed, and therefore hesitates to share their real situation

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Although he knows family and friends are available to talk to, he withdraws the urge to seek help and bears the pressure alone
Turns the energy for seeking outside help into self-consumption and worry

contact_model.definition: The individual suppresses feelings triggered by stimuli from the internal or external environment, not presenting or reducing presentation intensity when in contact with others.
manifestations: Trying not to express stress and fear in front of the children
Downplaying real feelings when talking about recent life with others

positive_force: Has multilingual ability, with prospects to broaden employment directions (English, French, Spanish)
Continuously and proactively job hunting (applying widely, contacting recruitment agencies, exploring remote and alternative income)
Has a potential support network of family and friends
Responsibility toward the children and care motivation provide intrinsic drive
negative_force: Tendency to catastrophize and predict the future, magnifying the worst outcomes
Self-labeling as a failure and shame hinder help-seeking and use of external support
Impaired sleep and persistent high anxiety, affecting daily functioning and job-search efficiency
Mental filtering: excessively focusing on not-yet-received replies and negative information, ignoring possible positive cues
Black-and-white thinking: views options such as moving as the only way out, thereby intensifying the feeling of 'being trapped'

target_behavior.behavior: High-intensity anxiety and catastrophic associations related to job searching
antecedent: Checking job postings but not yet received replies
Thinking about financial pressure and household expenses
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic interpretation of unemployment consequences and prediction of future failure (e.g. worrying about losing housing and becoming homeless)
target_behavior.function: Maintaining vigilance and a sense of control through worry, trying to avert risks in advance
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired sleep, decreased attention, reduced job-search efficiency, declining parent-child interaction quality

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids expressing genuine concerns to family or friends and seeking support
antecedent: When thinking about discussing financial and housing issues with relatives and friends
When asked about recent life by others
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and self-labeling as a failure; worries about being judged or making others worry
target_behavior.function: Escaping uncomfortable emotions and potential negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Social support resources not yet utilized, increased sense of isolation, anxiety maintained

target_behavior.behavior: Negative anticipation and giving up on remote or alternative work opportunities
antecedent: Seeing fierce competition for remote jobs
Considering relocation but with insufficient funds
target_behavior.core_reason: Black-and-white and future-predicting cognitive biases, prematurely concluding 'have no chance'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and disappointment, reducing discomfort in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Employment opportunities shrink, financial pressure persists, problems are maintained
